title: Hands-on task file: data/<NN-slug>/tasks.json
description: A Try or a Lab must have a non-empty cleanup list, a verify object, a cost line and a cost-if-forgotten line; a Look has an empty cleanup list and verify null. Those cross-field rules, the banned command patterns and the tag rule are checked by the task lint from SPEC.json (tasks.*).

title.description: becomes an H2 in 3-do.md: letters, digits, spaces and hyphens only

kills.description: the misconception this task kills, as the wrong belief in straight double quotes

section.description: '<file>#<section id>' the task sits next to; a Try or Lab has its Try it callout there

pass_route.description: true on exactly one Try of a chapter that has a Try; Look tasks are on the Fast route and carry false

template.description: Lab only: path of the template that builds the routine part, 'data/<NN-slug>/templates/<task id>.yaml'

cost.description: cost line, for example '$0' or 'under $0.10'; a dollar figure above zero needs a fact in cost_facts

cost_if_forgotten.description: what it costs per day if the cleanup is forgotten, for example 'about $1.10 a day' or '$0'

permissions.description: IAM actions or managed policy names the task needs

read_only_alternative.description: what to do in an account where she cannot create resources

still_costs.description: resources that still cost money if left

label.const: checked against docs, not run in a real account

text.description: names the thing to find or do, never a click path

command.description: one plain command for AWS CloudShell (prefixes: tasks.allowed_command_prefixes); can use $NAME of an earlier capture and <UPPER_CASE> placeholders that the step text explains

capture.description: keeps one value of the output for later steps; printed as NAME=$(<command> --query <query> --output text)

expect.description: the expected result, as she sees it; plain text without AWS facts

break_it.description: true for a break-it-on-purpose step; the next step is the fix

predict.description: the question to answer before running a break-it step

explain.description: break-it step: why the result happens; strict text with fact links
